units.notes: The language/platform half of the java track (Spring and libraries are the java-spring unit — skip them). Compare LTS lines 17, 21, 25 and every GA non-LTS release after 25 (26, and 27 if GA by today). Track JEPs through preview → final: records, sealed, pattern matching for switch/instanceof, record patterns, unnamed variables, virtual threads, structured concurrency, scoped values, string templates (withdrawn), flexible constructor bodies, module imports, compact source files/instance main, stream gatherers, FFM API, class-file API, generational ZGC, compact object headers, AOT cache, etc. — but take the list from openjdk.org/projects/jdk/<N>/ pages, not this note. The java track is parked at 160/232 topics — use PLANNED for syllabus items not yet written.
